fact: The draft roadmap, prepared 25 April to 10 May 2022, sets out an ICT and Digitalization Policy Roadmap 2022-2026 with key performance indicators and reports that 21 percent of key stakeholders were unaware of the National ICT Policy 2013.
title: Malawi ICT & Digitalization Policy Roadmap 2022 – 2026 (Draft)
publisher: The Presidential Delivery Unit Digitalization Labs
